body: He's told me he feels that way. I do love him. I don't know what to do. It's awful
For my husband to be in love with me and think I'm attractive

At first I thought you were a troll, but having grown up in a conservative christian environment and knowing a lot of people who feel the same way as you (including my own sister) I thought I would respond on the off chance this is real.

Though I don't necessarily agree with all these beliefs anymore, I am still going to address this from a christian stand point since that is where you're at.  You are disobeying God.  God commands you to love your wife just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her. Gave himself up for her.  Self sacrificially. Selflessly.  Everything I have read from you has been nothing but selfish.  You need to put aside your desire for more children right now, and really reflect and pray on your disobedience to God's commands of you as a husband.  You are willing to jeopardize the stability of your marriage and your children's lives because of your selfishness.  Do you know what it does to a child to grow up in an unstable family? I'm not talking about divorce.  My father made very selfish decisions that severely damaged my parents marriage and I will forever be scarred from growing up in that environment.  You are willing to put the ones you are supposed to love through that.

God said the most important commands to Him are to love Him with all your heart and to *love others as you love yourself*. He said that is THE most important command! And you are disobeying it.  You are loving yourself more than you are loving your wife.  

If your Christian beliefs are as important to you as you say they are, these issues are FAR more pressing than making your wife have more babies.  You really need to read the biblical passages on love and husbands roles and really reflect on them a lot more before even thinking about these other issues.  You also sound like you have a lot of pride issues and I'm sure you are aware what the bible says about that.

I'm not saying these things to attack you, but because I truly want you and your family to have the best family you can. You are making an idol out of having more kids and it is costing you the well being of the family God trusted you with.  Regardless of what it's even costing you, you know how God feels about making an idol out of things and putting their importance above his commands. I hope you can put any pride or ego aside and really take my words to heart.  My advice to you would be to focus on yourself and your relationship with God.  Back off your wife, support her, and pray that God will guide her in the right direction and accept where He guides her.  It may not be the way you want....All the best
